author: Ralf Junghanns
attribution: Photo: Ralf Junghanns, CC BY-SA 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Victoria_Falls_Station_Baboons.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Classic white railway station name board on two posts at Victoria Falls station; the distance lines (left) and altitude (right) are in small print. A leaf partly covers the final S of 'FALLS'. Baboons in the foreground are incidental. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

author: IGTaylor
attribution: Photo: IGTaylor, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Sign_at_entrance_of_Vuti_High_School_in_Zimbabwe.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Printed banner on a whitewashed entrance wall, Vuti; each letter of 'VUTI HIGH School' sits in its own white box. The 'IMPORTANT NOTICE' rules panel below (7 numbered rules, with 'VUTI' vertically on both sides) is regulatory text and left out. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.
source_title: File:Sign at entrance of Vuti High School in Zimbabwe.jpg

author: Gary Bembridge from London, UK
attribution: Photo: Gary Bembridge from London, UK, CC BY 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:2003_Little_Chef_Harare_Zimbabwe_557136110.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Hand-painted white board with a navy oval and a left arrow on a metal frame in Harare; 'the Works' in a decorative font. The 'THE LITTLE CHEF' fascia with a Coca-Cola panel on the building behind is a second business (alternative target, query 'The Little Chef'); people at the picnic tables are incidental.

author: Sichelesile
attribution: Photo: Sichelesile, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Pomongwe_Cave_site.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: White site board on two posts in Matobo National Park; red serif title. The litter request below ('THIS IS A WORLD HERITAGE SITE, SO PLEASE HELP US TO KEEP IT CLEAN AND TIDY. ...') and the logo strip are secondary. Slightly soft focus; visitors in the background are incidental.

author: Geraldshields11
attribution: Photo: Geraldshields11, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Victoria_Falls_National_Park_sign_001.jpeg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: White board on a green palisade fence under razor wire, with the Zimbabwe Parks and Wildlife crest and a KAZA logo; the KAZA panel at the left has a pink elephant image. A different sign from the Mosi-oa-Tunya stone (c147916193).

author: Geraldshields11
attribution: Photo: Geraldshields11, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Victoria_Falls,_Zimbabwe_sign_001.jpeg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Granite slab cut in the outline of Zimbabwe at the Victoria Falls rainforest entrance, with engraved UNESCO / World Heritage / Zimbabwe Parks logos below (small text not transcribed). Pepsi fridges, a 'NATIONAL PARK ... REST' sign behind and staff in the background are distractors.

author: Bernard Gagnon
attribution: Photo: Bernard Gagnon, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Victoria_Falls_viewpoint_-12,_Zimbabwe.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Yellow letters carved into a tilted wooden plank on a forked post (viewpoint no. 12 in the Victoria Falls rainforest). Letters are crowded with no spaces ('12LIVINGSTONEISLAND' on the sign), and both G's look like lowercase 'g'/'9'; spray mist across the upper left. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

author: callum.darragh

notes: Night shot of a headlight-lit green roundabout direction sign with a yellow route number; horizontal panel seams cross the face. The rest of the frame is black; a car's yellow number plate at the lower left is incidental.
